name: wkeep
expr: yc = wkeep(x, 4); yl = wkeep(x, 4, 'l'); yr = wkeep(x, 4, 'r'); yf = wkeep(x, 4, 3); y2c = wkeep(M, [3 3]); y2tl = wkeep(M, [3 3], [1 1]); y2br = wkeep(M, [3 3], [3 3]); ybad = wkeep(x, 9); yfrac = wkeep(x, 2.5); yneg = wkeep(x, -1); y0 = wkeep(x, 0); ysgl = wkeep(single(x), 4); yv23 = wkeep(x, [2 3]); ycol = wkeep([1;2;3;4;5;6;7;8], [2 1]);
comment: Sig: y = wkeep(x, n[, OPT]) (1-D) or y = wkeep(X, [R C][, [fr fc]]) (2-D). 1-D: 'c'/'l'/'r' or numeric start. 2-D: central [R C] sub-matrix or explicit corner. Bug fix 2026-05-08: 2-D form was throwing 'Cannot convert double to scalar' (adapter did toScalar on the size vec). tol=0. Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: class-preserving (single/logical/uint8/complex/char pass through); an INVALID len (non-integer, negative, >length) returns X UNCHANGED instead of erroring; len 0 = empty; a 2-element len on a VECTOR uses the dim-matching element only.
